question: I am aware how to cluster_by in a usual dbt modal. But I have been struggling how to do this for a dbt seed which doesn't have config available for it besides schema.yml. I can't find any documentation for it? Any help would be appreciated.
title: DBT: How to "cluster_by" in snowflake seeds
answer: The only configurations enabled for seeds are the ones stated in the docs here. So, there's no option to add a cluster_by key to them using dbt.
